content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

Selling beats online without conventional payment platforms means creators can avoid the high fees and restrictions imposed by services like Gumroad, which charges up to 10% on sales. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can utilize NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which only charges a mere 0.5%. This difference is crucial; for instance, selling 100 beats at $97 each could save you over $900 in fees compared to traditional platforms. This approach is not just about saving money; it’s about regaining control over your business and making your music accessible to a global audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the COREMERCH architecture utilizes a combination of free and low-cost tools. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as your storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. This setup ensures that once your store is live, it operates independently of any third-party platform. When a customer pays in crypto through NOWPayments, the transaction is verified on-chain, and your product is automatically delivered. This seamless integration allows you to focus on creating music while the system manages sales and delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors are either unavailable or heavily restricted. If you’re a beat maker in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, COREMERCH provides the tools you need to monetize your work without relying on platforms that charge exorbitant fees. By focusing on creators, COREMERCH empowers you to take charge of your sales process, allowing you to engage with your audience directly and maintain ownership of your intellectual property.
Save over $900 by avoiding high platform fees with COREMERCH.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The COREMERCH system consists of several key components that work in harmony. The Sovereign Starter Stack includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. The Edge Commerce Stack builds on this foundation with Cloudflare Pages and Workers, integrating Supabase for order management. Each element is designed to be user-friendly, ensuring that you can set up your digital store quickly and efficiently. With lifetime access to your infrastructure, you are not just a user; you are an owner.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your beats online, begin by selecting the COREMERCH stack that suits your needs. You can choose between the Sovereign Starter Stack for a basic setup or the Edge Commerce Stack for more advanced features. Set up your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, create your product listings, and integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, ensure your delivery system is in place, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. For detailed guidance, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which offers everything you need to build and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a sovereign commerce stack like COREMERCH. By leveraging tools such as GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto processing, you maintain control over your sales and avoid platform fees. This approach enables direct engagement with your customers while automating payment and delivery.
Take full ownership of your digital store without relying on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can automate product delivery by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to manage the backend logic of your store. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation.
